notes.text: DMs: type @ plus two letters of a username. Matching people pop up — pick the full name, or add someone new.
Chat @ mentions only your Workers roster bots, not people.
Office is the floor only. The fake Nudge-pair panel is gone. If 3D dies you still get the crew map — no crash banner.
Custom API keys route by prefix. Clearing a key returns you to NVIDIA NIM.
